title: Integrating Cryo Soft X-Ray Tomography into CLEM and Volume EM Correlative Workflows
content: While Electron Microscopy (EM) provides outstanding subcellular detail, it has limitations, including a lack of 3D cellular context, a restricted field of view, and demanding sample preparation protocols. These challenges are particularly evident when compared to light or X-ray microscopy. To overcome these limitations correlative workflows have been developed that combine light with FIB/SEM, SBF/SEM or Array tomography, thus facilitating the localization of specific regions of interest within an extended sample volume. Nonetheless, these workflows are largely restricted to chemically fixed samples, involve labor-intensive preparation, and offer limited native contrast for hydrated, cryo-preserved samples.
